mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_task (user_id, plan_id, content_id, training_date, status, scheduled_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{planId}, #{contentId}, #{trainingDate}, #{status}, #{scheduledAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, plan_id, content_id, training_date, status, scheduled_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM training_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND training_date = #{trainingDate}
